# Gain-map reader fixtures

These fixtures exercise `JxlGainMap` field parsing and color-data decoding.
The metadata values were compared with libultrahdr commit
`418b6b361e252a91c435a56cf386afb37d7d1c9d`. The ICC stream in `icc.jhgm` and
`combined.jhgm` decodes to the profile generated by
`JxlColorEncoding::srgb(false).maybe_create_profile()`; that profile's
SHA-256 is `72c4e9508ec4c8136b3cb708443e0557d0cb827f96bfd14b4255cbead1c0cf49`.
The compressed stream was produced with libjxl's `JxlICCProfileEncode`.

`want_icc.jhgm` is a manually assembled envelope whose structured field
requests the alternate ICC field. The three `truncated_*.jhgm` files declare
fields that end before their declared bounds. The nested 46-byte JPEG XL image
is frozen as a test constant in `tests/gain_map.rs`; its SHA-256 is
`e56a9cc44d28224881d42e0f0c63ac6f169dc35167347a0eb3d5285a3a345419`.

The 11 checked-in `.jhgm` fixtures consist of seven original fixtures and four
small synthetic fixtures. The original fixtures have these SHA-256 hashes:

```text
combined.jhgm            288a7fc2cd853416215eca079ee933f996643ac680bf5bae95544c2b4f0822e5
icc.jhgm                 49d05c78761339f495da3083f1af504803568fd21a90102a12f240294684fc17
structured.jhgm          f0a967552cdbd437b496c8493b7561d8e0cb443f369e930251a9f54a7fc26bbc
truncated_color.jhgm     66a2329e8f9fccb68c3eba8039d490999c3605fd3fc400a8db51a81571d26568
truncated_icc.jhgm       71f8c2f87c3a3ef1cd4e0adbdf08a7134e5011e9e51ed6fd27a136071ff6c381
truncated_metadata.jhgm  cf7605ed1bc735f6c825554154627467e1cac9df54cee8699218ed434603c568
want_icc.jhgm            83e4dd517651b884f17bce13478d09f2e56320d7fe2afe2f78642e3b582c6322
```

Four small synthetic `.jhgm` fixtures cover failure paths and ignored invalid
data:

```text
malformed_color.jhgm       32d8671d32c4707e901c3a1362129b67a89bee6d0c14d9708691665dfee00c4b
malformed_unused_icc.jhgm  5c300bcfb8ef893adb0e832e9b1662af8c7b511195341fd36def531c8d347d20
missing_icc.jhgm           93d040026370733eea2d26e1d9fb0775635e9967af397a6dfcd993c5a1c3598d
unsupported_version.jhgm  a8100ae6aa1940d0b663bb31cd466142ebbdbd5187131b92d93818987832eb89
```

The tests cover envelope fields, structured color and ICC decoding, retention
of the nested JPEG XL bytes, rejection of unsupported versions, selected-field
errors, ignored invalid ICC data, and malformed field bounds.
They do not decode nested images, capture outer JXL boxes, or apply gain-map
rendering.
